title: TailMux
summary: Multiple Tailscale tailnets at once, no switching + no VM
content: TailMux: Multiple Tailscale tailnets at once, no switching + no VM | Product Hunt Launching today TailMux Launching today Multiple Tailscale tailnets at once, no switching + no VM 106 followers Multiple Tailscale tailnets at once, no switching + no VM 106 followers Visit website VPN client The official Tailscale client keeps one tailnet active at a time. TailMux makes work and personal tailnets reachable simultaneously on macOS and Linux, without switching accounts, running multiple system daemons, or using a VM. It runs an isolated embedded node per profile and routes by hostname, with strict no-fallback isolation. Use SSH, RDP/SMB, browsers, curl, git, and npm across tailnets at the same time. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team More Payment Required Launch tags: Mac • Developer Tools • Security Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 12 Day Rank Upvote • 112 points Follow TailMux Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info tailmux.app TailMux Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/tailmux Similar Products Tailscale Best VPN Service for Secure Networks 4.3 ( 6 reviews ) VPN client Ngrok Secure introspectable tunnels to localhost 4.5 ( 13 reviews ) Command line tools Security software Netmaker Connect everything with a WireGuard® VPN 4.0 ( 3 reviews ) VPN client Automation tools Pangolin Open-source identity-based VPN & remote access platform VPN client Passepartout VPN An user-friendly OpenVPN® client for iOS and macOS VPN client View more Subscribe Sign in Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Claudio Quaglia Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋 I'm the maker. TailMux started as a personal annoyance: I run a work tailnet and a personal one, and the official client can only be active on one at a time. Fast user switching means constantly running tailscale switch and dropping the other connection. The workarounds (two daemons, userspace SOCKS5, a whole VM) all felt clunky on macOS, so I built something that runs an isolated embedded Tailscale node per tailnet and routes traffic by hostname suffix. Both tailnets are live at the same time, with strict isolation so nothing leaks between them. It covers SSH, RDP/SMB tunnels, per-tailnet browser routing, and routing curl/git/npm. It's a one-time $4.99 license (a year of updates, keep your version forever). It's not affiliated with Tailscale — just a companion tool. It scratched my own itch and I use it daily; I'd love feedback from anyone juggling multiple tailnets. Ask me anything. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team Awards More Free Launch tags: Open Source • Privacy • Artificial Intelligence Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 1 Day Rank Upvote • 580 points Follow Osaurus Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info osaurus.ai GitHub Osaurus Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/osaurus Similar Products Ollama The easiest way to run large language models locally 4.9 ( 36 reviews ) AI Infrastructure Tools LLM Developer Tools opencode Your terminal's AI agent, with any model you want 5.0 ( 31 reviews ) AI Coding Agents Command line tools Lyzr Private Agent SDKs to build Generative AI Applications 5.0 ( 13 reviews ) AI Infrastructure Tools Thinkbuddy AI Native ChatGPT for MacOS - voice first AI + GPT4 vision 4.9 ( 8 reviews ) AI Generative Media LLMs Snaply Free & private AI, designed for you Mac 5.0 ( 6 reviews ) Writing assistants AI notetakers View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment tpae Osaurus Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt, I'm Terence, founder of Osaurus . I spent 20 years shipping software at Netflix, Tesla, and Zillow before going all in on this. Own your AI. Osaurus is an open source AI agent platform that runs on your Mac. MIT licensed, native Swift for Apple Silicon. No account, no subscription, no Electron . We started as Dinoki , a 5MB desktop dinosaur, and grew into a full agent platform through open source community feedback. Now at 7K+ GitHub stars and 175K+ downloads — all by word of mouth. The problem: most AI assistants run on someone else's server. Your files, memory, and context leave your machine every time you use them, usually behind a monthly subscription. Osaurus keeps all of it on your Mac. What that means in practice: Agents read your Calendar, look up Contacts, send iMessages, and work with your real files An isolated sandbox writes and runs code, producing real files on your desktop: images, PDFs, presentations Every action goes through an approval gate. You see what the agent wants to do before it does it Local models run fully offline. We built our own Swift MLX runtime, no Python underneath Want a frontier model? Bring your own key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) or use pay-as-you-go Osaurus Cloud. Either way, your memory and context stay local It's free and always will be. 16GB of RAM gets you started with local models, 24GB recommended. Try it at osaurus.ai . Download takes seconds, no account needed. I'll be here all day answering questions

content: Knockoff: Amazon, without the knockoffs | Product Hunt Launching today Knockoff Launching today Amazon, without the knockoffs 194 followers Amazon, without the knockoffs 194 followers Visit website Ad blockers • Chrome Extensions Knockoff filters the trademark-squat pseudo-brands (the SZHLUXes and HORUSDYs) out of your search results, so what's left is brands with a reputation to lose. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team More Free Launch tags: Browser Extensions • Amazon • GitHub Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 6 Day Rank Upvote • 210 points Follow Knockoff Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info knockoff.co GitHub Knockoff Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/knockoff-2 Similar Products Finch Browser Extension We help you shop more sustainably 4.8 ( 6 reviews ) Chrome Extensions Shopping Amazon Lite Removes ads, sponsored products and other clutter on Amazon Ad blockers Branalyzer Brand's Instant Analyzer Analyze brand Traffic, Competitors, Ads, Trustpilot, Social. 4.9 ( 27 reviews ) SEO tools Keyword research tools BuyScout® AI Shopping Assistant Your AI Copilot for Online Shopping 4.5 ( 2 reviews ) Chrome Extensions Shopping Wisely AI assistant to help you shop wisely on Amazon 5.0 ( 3 reviews ) AI Chatbots Chrome Extensions View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Xuefei Mei Curious how Knockoff decides something is likely a knockoff on Amazon. Is it looking at seller history, review patterns, brand matching, listing text, or some mix of signals? The browser extension angle is interesting, but I’d want to understand how it avoids hiding legitimate third-party sellers or small brands that just don’t have much review history yet. Upvote (3) Report Share 19h ago Josh Pigford Knockoff Maker @crystalmei Three signals. A register of 5,500+ established brands: names on it are left alone. A linguistic score for unknown names, tuned to the signature of trademark-squat pseudo-brands (ALL-CAPS strings, vanishing vowels, improbable consonant runs). And a community list built from user reports, which reaches every install within a day. Verdicts are heuristics plus lists. Certainly not perfect, but it's improving every day (thanks to thousands of community contributions). Upvote (1) Report Share 18h ago Laiba Love the concept! It's becoming increasingly difficult to tell which brands are legitimate on large marketplaces. Curious...how do you decide whether a brand gets a green check or a warning? Nice work! 👏 Upvote (1) Report Share 19h ago Josh Pigford Knockoff Maker @worksforme Full breakdown of how it works in the OSS repo: https://github.com/Shpigford/knockoff#how-it-works Upvote (1) Report Share 18h ago Derrick Zhang Super clean UI! I've been looking for a reliable Fakespot alternative and this seems perfect. Quick question: How often is the brand register refreshed? Rooting for you guys! 🚀 Upvote Report Share
